Glen Campbell's "Southern Nights" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Southern Nights" is a song written and performed by American musician Allen Toussaint, from his 1975 album, Southern Nights, and later recorded by American country music singer Glen Campbell.

Song history
The lyrics of "Southern Nights" were inspired by childhood memories Allen Toussaint had of visiting relatives in the Louisiana backwoods, which often entailed storytelling under star-filled nighttime skies.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Southern Nights is an album by American singer and guitarist Glen Campbell, released in 1977 by Capitol Records.

The album peaked at number one on the Billboard Top Country Albums chart, and one of the singles from the album, "Southern Nights" (a cover of the song by Allen Toussaint), also reached the number one spot on both the Billboard Hot 100 and Hot Country Songs charts.
